f. Scop© — Covers limiting dimensions and tolerances for tyre valve threads 9V1, 10 V2 and 12V1. 

2. Designation — Valve threads shall be designated as follows: 

Nominal Dimensions Designation 
mm 
9'4 X 0794 9V1 

10-3 x 0-907 10V2 

12-2 x 0-977 12V1 

3. Dimensions and tolerances shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Thread Gauging — Shall be according to IS : 2334-1975 ' Gauging practice for ISO metric screw 
threads ( first revision ) *. 

4.1 Values as given in Table 1 have been calculated so that it is possible to apply to the threads 
thus defined the limit gauge inspection principles specified in IS : 2334-1975. 

For the fabrication of the gauges, the following tolerances extracted from IS : 2334 have 
been chosen: 

Pitch diameter to external thread cf«: 
24 /*m < r« < 50 /*m 

Outside diameter of external thread of: 
36 /*m < 7* < 85 /urn 

Pitch diameter of Internal thread D%\ 
24 fitn < Tdi < 50 pm 

Inside diameter of internal thread D\i 
38 pm < Tdi < 100 pm 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Tyre valve threads are special threads for valves used with tyre tubes. These threads are 
different frbm those covered by IS : 4218 ' ISO matric screw threads '. This Indian Standard 
(Part 2 ) is 8ne of a series of standards on tyre valva threads. Other Indian standards in this 
series are IS : 9449 ( Part 1 )-1980 covering 5V1, 5V2, 6V1 and 8V1 threads and IS : 9449 ( Part 3 ) 
covers threads 10V1, 15V1, 17V1 and 20V1. 

This and other parts of this standard are in conformity with corresponding parts of ISO 4570 
'Tyre valve threads', issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO). 
Hpwever, tyres valve threads 10V2 covered by ISO 4570/II has not been covered by the Indian 
Standards as this size of thread is now obsolete.
